annotation.authors_or_issuer: Maritime Administration (MARAD), U.S. Department of Transportation
annotation.venue: Code of Federal Regulations (46 CFR Part 298) / Federal Register
annotation.summary_en: This is the US federal regulation (46 CFR Part 298) for MARAD's Vessel and Shipyard Financing Program, published at 91 FR 55491 in August 2026. It sets credit standards, eligibility rules, fees, foreign-component waivers, collateral and mortgage rules, and default procedures for federal guarantees on loans for building vessels and modernising shipyards. It does not cover AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: MARAD guarantees FFB-purchased notes financing vessel construction, repair and shipyard modernisation
Applicants must be US citizens; vessels must be US-built, US-flagged and meet Coast Guard and classification standards
Applications are prioritised for vessels suitable as naval or military auxiliaries, then Vessels of National Interest
Foreign components are excluded from Actual Cost unless MARAD grants a waiver
Application, commitment, guarantee and modification fees are set, along with collateral and recourse requirements
